title: First customers
subtitle: Log every sale by voice, keep track of who asked, and set up the free tools that bring orders.

diary.title: Sales diary
diary.subtitle: Just say it: "Sold 2 {item} to Priya for 400" or "Spent 300 on supplies".
diary.customersHint: Tap a status to change it. Follow up with people who asked but haven't ordered.
diary.noCustomers: Customers you mention in the diary show up here.
diary.followUpMessage: Hi {name}! 😊 Just checking if you'd like to place an order this week. Happy to make it fresh for you!

kit.title: Your free starter kit
kit.privacy: We never ask for or store your UPI ID, bank or phone details.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business catalogue
whatsapp.s1: Install WhatsApp Business (free) with your business number.
whatsapp.s2: Add a profile photo, short description, area and hours.
whatsapp.s3: Add 3–5 products to the catalogue with clear photos and prices.

upi.title: UPI QR for payments
upi.s1: Open your bank's app or a UPI app you already use.
upi.s2: Find "Receive money" or "My QR" and download the QR.
upi.s3: Print it, stick it near your packing table, and add it to your WhatsApp catalogue.

google.title: Google Business Profile
google.s1: Go to business.google.com and sign in with Google.
google.s2: Add your business name and area (you can hide your home address).
google.s3: Add photos and ask your first happy customers for a review.
